title: I like music · I hate exams

exercises.instruction: Как вы к этому относитесь? Выберите семь слов из рамки и напишите предложения с: I like … I don’t like … I love … или I hate …
Вы этим интересуетесь? Напишите предложения, используя фразы из рамки:

modelAnswers: I don’t know much about art.
I don’t know anything about astronomy.
I know a little about economics.

options: My favourite sport is football.
My favourite sport is the football.
I like this hotel. Rooms are very nice.
I like this hotel. The rooms are very nice.
Everybody needs friends.
Everybody needs the friends.
Jane doesn’t go to parties very often.
Jane doesn’t go to the parties very often.
I went shopping this morning. Shops were very busy.
I went shopping this morning. The shops were very busy.
‘Where’s milk?’ ‘It’s in the fridge.’
‘Where’s the milk?’ ‘It’s in the fridge.’
I don’t like milk. I never drink it.
I don’t like the milk. I never drink it.
‘Do you do any sports?’ ‘Yes, I play basketball.’
‘Do you do any sports?’ ‘Yes, I play the basketball.’
An architect is a person who designs buildings.
An architect is a person who designs the buildings.
We went for a swim in the river. Water was very cold.
We went for a swim in the river. The water was very cold.
I don’t like swimming in cold water.
I don’t like swimming in the cold water.
Excuse me, can you pass salt, please?
Excuse me, can you pass the salt, please?
I like this town. I like people here.
I like this town. I like the people here.
Vegetables are good for you.
The vegetables are good for you.
Houses in this street are all the same.
The houses in this street are all the same.
I can’t sing this song. I don’t know words.
I can’t sing this song. I don’t know the words.
I enjoy taking pictures. It’s my hobby.
I enjoy taking the pictures. It’s my hobby.
Do you want to see pictures that I took when I was on holiday?
Do you want to see the pictures that I took when I was on holiday?
English is used a lot in international business.
English is used a lot in the international business.
The English is used a lot in international business.
The English is used a lot in the international business.
Money doesn’t always bring happiness.
Money doesn’t always bring the happiness.
The money doesn’t always bring happiness.
The money doesn’t always bring the happiness.

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (работа по домy = housework; предмет = subject; выращивать = grow)

items.prompt: Анна любит фильмы, но она не любит книги.
answers: Anna loves films but she doesn’t like books.

items.prompt: Вчера мы ходили на концерт. Музыка была замечательная.
answers: We went to a concert yesterday. The music was great.
Yesterday we went to a concert. The music was great.

items.prompt: Вы выращиваете цветы в своём саду?
answers: Do you grow flowers in your garden?

items.prompt: Мы ездили в Париж. Музеи были очень интересные.
answers: We went to Paris. The museums were very interesting.

items.prompt: Я говорю по-французски, но я не знаю историю Франции.
answers: I speak French, but I don’t know the history of France.
